note: Export side is factually confirmed: five dated customs export records with B/L numbers, destinations (Sri Lanka, Nepal, Zambia, Kenya, UAE) and HS 84388090 — actual food-processing machinery shipments, not website claims. Note the declared HS in the batch (843860, machinery for the preparation of fruits/nuts) differs from the HS actually used on every visible shipment record (84388090, other machinery for the industrial preparation/manufacture of food or drink). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual 84388090 and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. The company also appears as an importer (suppliers: Jinan Saibainuo Machinery, Jinan Sinopuff Machinery, Yangzhou Leneng Machinery, China), i.e. it imports Chinese machines and re-exports — role is manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence: NOT established. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as confirmed or denied; no domestic figure is invented. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figures found. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is inconsistent with the observed goods (food-processing machinery, HS 8438) and should be corrected.
